articles.title: High-Speed Lorry Crashes Into Auto Near Ponnani Theatre, Driver Critically Injured
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A serious road accident was reported near Alankar Theatre on the Ponnani–Nariparamba road in Kerala after a speeding lorry allegedly collided with an auto-rickshaw, leaving the auto driver critically injured. The incident took place at around 9:10 AM on May 9.

body.html:
A serious road accident was reported near Alankar Theatre on the Ponnani–Nariparamba road in Kerala after a speeding lorry allegedly collided with an auto-rickshaw, leaving the auto driver critically injured.

The incident took place at around 9:10 AM on May 9.

The injured auto-rickshaw driver has been identified as Rasikh, a resident of Puthuponnani Jeelani Nagar in Ponnani.

According to reports, the lorry allegedly lost control while taking a turn at high speed and crashed head-on into the auto-rickshaw near the theatre premises. The impact reportedly destroyed the auto-rickshaw completely.

Local residents and Squad 54 ambulance workers rushed to the spot and rescued the unconscious driver from the wreckage.

Rasikh was initially shifted to a private hospital in Edappal for emergency treatment and stabilisation. Due to the seriousness of his injuries, he was later transferred in a specialised ICU ambulance to Kozhikode Medical College Hospital for advanced treatment. Some local reports also mentioned a transfer to Thrissur Medical College Hospital.

Police have reportedly secured CCTV footage from the accident spot and launched an investigation into the role of the lorry driver in the crash.

Further investigation is underway.

#Ponnani #Kerala #RoadAccident #BreakingNews #AutoRickshaw

articles.title: Zomato Delivery Worker Accused of Stealing Water Tap from Temple’s Free Drinking Kiosk in Hapur
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A food delivery company employee has been accused of stealing a water tap from a public drinking water kiosk installed at a temple complex in Uttar Pradesh’s Hapur district.

body.html:
A food delivery company employee has been accused of stealing a water tap from a public drinking water kiosk installed at a temple complex in Uttar Pradesh’s Hapur district.

The incident reportedly took place at Divya Balaji Dham in the Kotwali area of Hapur and was captured on CCTV cameras installed at the site.

According to temple authorities, the Ganga-Jamuna Siddhpeeth complex had set up a free cool drinking water facility for devotees, travellers, and passersby as part of a public service initiative during the intense summer heat.

Temple officials alleged that a delivery worker associated with Zomato removed one of the taps from the water kiosk. CCTV footage from the premises reportedly captured the act.

Temple Mahant Acharya Yashvardhan condemned the incident and termed it unfortunate, stating that such acts obstruct public welfare and religious service activities meant for common people.

The temple administration has demanded a fair investigation and strict action against the accused.

Officials also clarified that despite the incident, the temple will continue its public welfare initiatives, including the free drinking water service.

Inspector Manish Chauhan, in-charge of Hapur City Police Station, said the matter has been reported and CCTV footage clearly shows the accused allegedly removing the tap from the stall.

Police identified and arrested the individual and legal action will be taken accordingly.

#Hapur #UttarPradesh #BreakingNews #Zomato #CCTV

articles.title: ‘Ganja-Fuelled’ Machete Rampage Sparks Panic in JJ Nagar, Residents Allege Police Inaction
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Panic spread across JJ Nagar after a group of youths allegedly under the influence of ganja went on a violent rampage in the locality, attacking residents and looting valuables.

body.html:
Panic spread across JJ Nagar after a group of youths allegedly under the influence of ganja went on a violent rampage in the locality, attacking residents and looting valuables.

According to reports, the incident took place on the 5th of this month when the gang allegedly entered the area armed with machetes.

Residents claimed the accused assaulted people indiscriminately and snatched cash and mobile phones from locals. Those who attempted to question or resist the group were reportedly attacked with machetes.

The incident created fear and chaos in the locality, with several residents alleging that the gang moved around openly threatening people.

An FIR has been registered at JJ Nagar Police Station in connection with the violence and robbery.

However, locals have expressed anger over the police response, alleging that only one or two accused have been arrested so far while several others involved in the attack are still absconding.

Residents are now demanding immediate action and the arrest of all accused involved in the alleged machete attacks and robberies.

Police said further investigation into the case is underway.

articles.title: Engineering Dropout Arrested for Assaulting Cops During College Fest Noise Dispute in Karnataka
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Police have arrested a student in connection with the alleged assault on police personnel near Nagarjuna College in Karnataka’s Chikkaballapura district following a dispute over modified bike silencers and loud noise during a college fest.

body.html:
Police have arrested a student in connection with the alleged assault on police personnel near Nagarjuna College in Karnataka’s Chikkaballapura district following a dispute over modified bike silencers and loud noise during a college fest.

The arrested accused has been identified as Jaswanth, a native of Pavagada, who has been named as accused number two (A2) in the case. Police said he had studied engineering but dropped out midway.

According to investigators, Jaswanth had attended the “Ikya Fest” programme organised at Nagarjuna College near Beechaganahalli in Chikkaballapura taluk.

The incident reportedly took place last Friday under the jurisdiction of Nandigiridhama Police Station during bandobast duty at the event.

Police said a group of students arrived near the college gate on motorcycles fitted with modified silencers, allegedly creating excessive and disturbing noise by revving their bikes repeatedly.

Assistant Sub-Inspector Gangaraju and Police Constable Gangaraju, who were deployed at the venue, reportedly warned the students that altered silencers were illegal and asked them to leave the area.

According to police, while most students dispersed, Jaswanth and another accused identified as Rajesh allegedly argued with the officers, abused them, and physically assaulted the policemen.

Officials stated that ASI Gangaraju was attacked while in uniform and both officers were allegedly pushed to the ground during the altercation.

An FIR has been registered against Jaswanth, Rajesh, and several other students under sections related to assault on public servants, obstruction of duty, and public nuisance.

Police confirmed that Jaswanth has been arrested and is currently being interrogated, while efforts are underway to trace the prime accused Rajesh (A1) and other suspects involved in the attack.

Further investigation is ongoing.

#Karnataka #Chikkaballapura #BreakingNews #PoliceAssault #CollegeFest

articles.title: Ex-Army Man Accused of Random Triple Murders Killed in UP Encounter
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An ex-Army personnel accused of carrying out a series of random killings in Uttar Pradesh’s Chandauli district was killed in a police encounter on Sunday after allegedly opening fire on a police team during a crime scene reconstruction exercise.

body.html:
An ex-Army personnel accused of carrying out a series of random killings in Uttar Pradesh’s Chandauli district was killed in a police encounter on Sunday after allegedly opening fire on a police team during a crime scene reconstruction exercise.

The accused, identified as Gurpreet Singh, was in police custody in connection with the suspected murder of three people, including a woman, within the Alinagar police station limits over the past 48 hours.

According to Superintendent of Police Akash Patel, three separate shooting incidents took place between May 10 and 11 in which three individuals were killed.

Police said Gurpreet Singh was apprehended by members of the public after the murder of a woman and was later taken into custody.

SP Akash Patel stated that Gurpreet had been discharged from the Army in 2021. Police said he later travelled from Punjab to Bihar on April 29 to work as a security guard but allegedly lost the job due to alcohol addiction.

Investigators claimed he had been suffering from severe anger and mental distress following his dismissal.

According to police, the accused allegedly shot dead one man aboard a passenger train on May 10, killed another man on a separate train, and later shot a woman at a hospital.

During interrogation, Gurpreet allegedly told police that he was committing murders randomly out of rage and had no personal enmity with the victims.

Police said the accused was later taken to the crime scenes for reconstruction of events. During the process, he allegedly tried to escape and opened fire on the police team.

“In retaliatory firing, he sustained two bullet injuries and was taken to hospital, where doctors declared him dead,” SP Akash Patel said.

Police said further investigation into the case is ongoing.

articles.title: Family Performs ‘Last Rites’ of Living Daughter After Love Marriage, Couple Forced Into Hiding
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking incident from Bihar’s Muzaffarpur district, a family allegedly performed the symbolic last rites of their living daughter after she married her boyfriend against their wishes following an eight-year relationship.

body.html:
In a shocking incident from Bihar’s Muzaffarpur district, a family allegedly performed the symbolic last rites of their living daughter after she married her boyfriend against their wishes following an eight-year relationship.

The incident was reported from a village in the Madwan block area, where the family, under alleged social pressure and fear of boycott, carried out funeral rituals for the 20-year-old woman despite her being alive.

According to reports, the woman had married her boyfriend through a court marriage in Patna on April 10 after leaving her home on April 6.

Speaking to media, the woman said she had been in a relationship with the man for the past eight years and had repeatedly informed her family about her wish to marry him. However, the family allegedly refused to accept the relationship.

“I left my home of my own free will. Because of society, my family performed my last rites. Under pressure from society, they are saying they will kill the boy and girl wherever they find us,” she alleged.

After she left home, her father reportedly lodged a kidnapping complaint at Karja police station on April 8, alleging that she had been abducted by two men on a motorcycle.

However, when police later traced the couple and presented the woman before a court, she reportedly stated that she was an adult and had married her boyfriend voluntarily.

“I married my lover of my own free will and want to live with my husband,” she reportedly told the court. Following her statement, police allowed her to leave with her husband.

Reports said the woman’s family faced intense social pressure from villagers and members of the community after the marriage became known. A social boycott was allegedly imposed on the family, with claims that villagers stopped interacting or maintaining social ties with them.

According to reports, the family was allegedly told that they would only be accepted back into the community if they declared their daughter “dead” and performed her last rites.

Under this alleged pressure, the family prepared an effigy representing the woman, placed her photograph on a decorated bier, and carried out a funeral procession through the village with villagers participating.

The effigy was later cremated at the cremation ground following Hindu funeral rituals and chanting by priests.

The woman and her husband are currently reportedly living in hiding, claiming they fear for their safety due to threats from family and community members.

Legal experts have pointed out that the Indian Constitution grants every adult the right to choose a life partner and marry voluntarily. They also noted that social boycott and intimidation over marriage choices may violate fundamental rights and personal liberty.

#Bihar #Muzaffarpur #LoveMarriage #BreakingNews #SocialBoycott

articles.title: Panic at Ajmer Sharif Dargah After Youth Jumps Into ‘Badi Deg’
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Panic briefly erupted at Rajasthan’s famous Ajmer Sharif Dargah after a young man allegedly jumped into the shrine’s giant ceremonial cauldron, known as the ‘Badi Deg’, inside the dargah premises. The entire incident was captured on CCTV cameras installed within the shrine complex.

body.html:
Panic briefly erupted at Rajasthan’s famous Ajmer Sharif Dargah after a young man allegedly jumped into the shrine’s giant ceremonial cauldron, known as the ‘Badi Deg’, inside the dargah premises.

The entire incident was captured on CCTV cameras installed within the shrine complex.

According to eyewitnesses, the youth suddenly ran towards the massive cauldron while attendants and khadims attempted to stop him. However, before they could restrain him, he reportedly climbed into the Deg, triggering chaos among devotees present at the shrine.

Sources said cash offerings and jewellery donated by devotees were present inside the cauldron at the time of the incident.

Videos from the scene, which have now gone viral on social media, show the man sitting inside the Deg while caretakers and devotees repeatedly ask him to come out safely.

When repeated attempts to convince him reportedly failed, one of the khadims climbed into the cauldron himself and, after considerable effort, managed to pull the youth out safely.

Some reports also claimed that the youth was beaten by a few staff members during the rescue attempt.

Preliminary information suggests that the youth may be mentally unstable, although his identity and exact motive are yet to be confirmed.

Following the incident, the man was reportedly handed over to police for questioning.

No serious injuries or major damage were reported in the incident. Police said no formal complaint has been filed by any party so far.

The Dargah committee, local police, and administrative officials are currently examining CCTV footage and investigating the matter.

The Ajmer Sharif Dargah, dedicated to Sufi saint Khwaja Moinuddin Hasan Chishti, is one of India’s most visited spiritual sites and attracts thousands of devotees daily.

#Ajmer #Rajasthan #AjmerSharif #BreakingNews #ViralVideo #CCTV

articles.title: CCTV Captures Shocking Abduction of Woman and 3-Month-Old Baby by Live-in Partner in MP
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 22-year-old woman and her three-month-old daughter were allegedly abducted by her live-in partner and his accomplices from their residence in Madhya Pradesh’s Shivpuri district, police said.

body.html:
A 22-year-old woman and her three-month-old daughter were allegedly abducted by her live-in partner and his accomplices from their residence in Madhya Pradesh’s Shivpuri district, police said.

The incident took place under the Kotwali police station area and was reportedly captured on CCTV cameras installed in the locality.

Police have registered an FIR under multiple sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), including charges related to assault, criminal intimidation, kidnapping, and provisions of the SC/ST Act.

The victim has been identified as Mahak Guharia, daughter of Triptesh Guharia, a resident near Shivpuri Public School. The accused has been identified as Pushpendra Chauhan, a resident of Karera.

According to the complaint filed by Mahak’s mother, Neelam Guharia, Mahak and Pushpendra had been living together in Indore for the past three years and also had a three-month-old daughter named Aarohi.

However, due to alleged harassment by Pushpendra, Mahak recently returned to Shivpuri with her baby and started staying with her family.

Neelam alleged that after Mahak returned home, Pushpendra repeatedly threatened the family and pressured Mahak to return with him. When she refused, he allegedly threatened to abduct her.

According to police, on Friday night around 8:35 pm, Pushpendra allegedly arrived at the house along with around 10 accomplices.

The accused was reportedly carrying a weapon, while others were armed with hockey sticks and clubs.

The family alleged that the group entered the house, verbally abused them using caste-based slurs, and physically assaulted family members. Mahak’s parents, Neelam and Triptesh Guharia, reportedly sustained injuries during the attack.

The complaint further stated that the accused also pushed the infant before forcibly taking Mahak and the baby into a white car and fleeing the scene.

The family claimed the accused threatened to kill anyone who attempted to stop or follow them.

Kotwali police have registered a case against Pushpendra and his accomplices and launched an investigation into the incident.

#MadhyaPradesh #Shivpuri #BreakingNews #Kidnapping #CCTV

articles.title: Newlywed Bride ‘Elopes with Lover After Stealing ₹21 Lakh Gold’ in Belagavi, Both Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a cinema-style case from Karnataka’s Belagavi district, a newlywed woman allegedly conspired with her lover to rob her husband’s house and flee with gold ornaments to start a new life together. Police have arrested both the woman and her lover and recovered the stolen valuables.

body.html:
In a cinema-style case from Karnataka’s Belagavi district, a newlywed woman allegedly conspired with her lover to rob her husband’s house and flee with gold ornaments to start a new life together.

Police have arrested both the woman and her lover and recovered the stolen valuables.

The accused woman, identified as Haseena Nadaph, had married Shareef, a resident of Hosakote village, around two months ago. However, according to police, she was already in a relationship with Hanamanth Marapur before the marriage, and the affair allegedly continued even after the wedding.

The incident was reported from Hosakote village in Ramdurg taluk of Belagavi district.

Police said Haseena allegedly took advantage of the absence of family members and stole around 154.6 grams of gold ornaments worth approximately ₹21 lakh, along with 45 grams of silver ornaments, from her husband’s house.

Investigators suspect she had planned to elope with her lover after carrying out the theft.

Following a complaint filed at Katakol Police Station by Shareef’s relative, Dilshan Nadaph, police launched an investigation into the case.

Officials said suspicion quickly fell on Haseena, and within 48 hours, police traced and arrested both accused.

The stolen gold ornaments were also recovered from the duo.

Police later produced the accused before a court, which remanded them to judicial custody.

#Belagavi #Karnataka #BreakingNews #GoldTheft #CrimeNews
